boundaries.name: GoldilocksFieldSemantics
boundaries.obligation: plonky2's GoldilocksField has the canonical-value semantics the vendored math assumes (p = 2^64 - 2^32 + 1).

boundaries.name: Bytes32DigestType
boundaries.obligation: Every signed message is a domain-separated 32-byte keccak digest; the model treats digests as opaque values.

boundaries.name: ZeroizeSecretHandling
boundaries.obligation: Secret material is wiped as claimed; not modelled.

boundaries.name: ByteIoRefinement
boundaries.obligation: The trait-based byte plumbing refines the list-level encode/decode functions the model uses.
